title: Guide page and README: why harvest and QA run apart, what the status line and personal rules offer, and an owner credit
story: The guide page has a new section explaining why harvest and QA run later as one batch, what the optional status bar shows, and what the personal rules do; its footer credits the owner. The README carries the same three explanations briefly.

checks.criterion: The guide explains the three choices.
checks.steps: Open docs/guide/index.html in a browser and click Why in the top menu.
checks.expected: Three boxes: Harvest and QA run apart, The status bar (optional), Your personal rules; the first mentions about 30 minutes on every pull request, the second names the unstaged count, the third shows Risk (open): and Risk (fixed):.

checks.criterion: The footer credits the owner and the page loads nothing from elsewhere.
checks.steps: Open the page with the network off and scroll to the bottom.
checks.expected: Built for Claude Code · Made by followed by the owner's name, and the page fully styled.

checks.criterion: The README carries the explanations briefly.
checks.expected: A Why it works this way section with three bullets just above License.
